doesNotKnow: Combine orientation signs with bounding-box tests to detect proper and collinear segment intersections.

misconception: Opposite orientation signs alone cover every touching and collinear case.
objective: Combine orientation signs with bounding-box tests to detect proper and collinear segment intersections.

claims.text: Zero orientation means collinearity, not automatic intersection. The bounding test checks whether an endpoint actually lies on the other segment, distinguishing overlapping and separated collinear inputs.
